root_cause_label: Ephemeral Background Web Server Not Made Persistent
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent started the web server as a transient background process without ensuring it would persist after the session, so the grader finds no running HTTP server when it evaluates the setup.
t_err_evidence: Step 9: agent starts python3 -m http.server 8080 as a background job ('&') tied to the shell session, with no mechanism (e.g., systemd unit, nohup with process supervision, or a startup script) to keep it alive after the session ends.
t_commit_evidence: Step 9 is also the commit point: after launching the ephemeral server the agent proceeds to test (steps 10-16) and then claims success (step 17) without ever revisiting or hardening the web server persistence. The transient process is irreversibly baked into the solution from this step onward.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed that a background process started with '&' inside a shell session would remain alive when the grader evaluates the task after the session ends. In containerized/test environments the background job is tied to the parent shell and is killed when that shell exits, so the HTTP server is gone by grading time.
